evidence.title: Enjoy a month of T-Mobile 5G Home Internet on them and up to $200 back

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet plan pricing page
occurrences.quote_span: Customers can choose from three plans—Rely, Amplified, and All-In—with prices starting at $35 a month.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet service and installation documentation
occurrences.quote_span: The service uses T-Mobile's 5G cellular network, allowing for a simple self-installation process without a technician.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet promotion terms
occurrences.quote_span: T-Mobile is offering new promotions for its 5G Home Internet service, including rebates and a first month of service offer.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile 5-Year Price Guarantee terms for new home internet customers
occurrences.quote_span: T-Mobile offers a 5-Year Price Guarantee for new home internet customers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile self-installation instructions and setup documentation
occurrences.quote_span: The self-install process can take about 15 minutes, making the service particularly appealing to renters, recent movers or anyone who doesn't want to deal with a traditional installation appointment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile Amplified plan pricing and feature documentation
occurrences.quote_span: Starting at $45 a month, T-Mobile lists a premium Wi-Fi 7 Gateway, no speed caps and a $100 prepaid Mastercard among the plan's features.
occurrences.speaker: T-Mobile
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile promotion terms and virtual prepaid Mastercard offer details
occurrences.quote_span: The current promotion offers your first month of service on T-Mobile and up to $200 back through a virtual prepaid Mastercard with AutoPay and a voice line.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile All-In plan pricing and feature documentation
occurrences.quote_span: All-In is the most feature-packed option, starting at $55 a month, adding benefits such as a Wi-Fi mesh extender, Advanced Cyber Security, 24/7 tech support, a Gateway upgrade after three years and streaming perks.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile Amplified plan specifications and equipment documentation
occurrences.quote_span: Amplified adds faster speeds and upgraded equipment for customers who want more performance from their home network.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile All-In plan terms and promotion details
occurrences.quote_span: Hulu and Paramount+ are included with the plan. This plan comes with a $200 prepaid Mastercard.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet installation and equipment documentation
occurrences.quote_span: This internet service delivers home Wi-Fi through T-Mobile's 5G network rather than traditional cable or fiber lines, which means there's no drilling or technician installation required, and getting connected can be as simple as plugging in the included 5G Gateway and following the setup instructions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile 5-Year Price Guarantee terms for home internet
occurrences.quote_span: T-Mobile includes a 5-Year Price Guarantee, ensuring the monthly rate will not increase for at least five years.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile qualifying 5G Home Internet offer terms
occurrences.quote_span: But now, T-Mobile is making it easier to save on faster home internet with an offer that includes your first month of service on T-Mobile and up to $200 back on qualifying 5G Home Internet plans when you set up AutoPay and add a voice line.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile Price Guarantee terms and customer pricing records
occurrences.quote_span: This means the monthly rate for your 5G data plan is protected from price hikes for at least five years, giving you long-term budget stability that traditional internet service providers rarely match.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile prepaid Mastercard promotion registration terms
occurrences.quote_span: Customers must register the promotional code for their prepaid Mastercard within 30 days of activating a qualifying new internet line.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile home internet availability checker and service terms
occurrences.quote_span: Service availability and speeds vary by location and can be checked on the T-Mobile website.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile home internet signup flow and address eligibility checker
occurrences.quote_span: Before signing up, you'll need to enter your address on T-Mobile's website to see which plans are available at your home.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile home internet customer agreement, fees, and trial terms
occurrences.quote_span: There are also no annual contracts or monthly equipment fees listed for the service and T-Mobile offers a 15-day worry-free trial for eligible customers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet

occurrences.checkable_against: T-Mobile Rely plan pricing, features, and promotion terms
occurrences.quote_span: Starting at $35 a month, Rely is T-Mobile's basic-level home internet option for households looking for straightforward 5G connectivity. It includes unlimited data, a 5G Gateway and a $100 prepaid Mastercard.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet
